boundaryZh: 这些条目用于改进方法文档、数据透明度和验证治理，不是材料性能证据，也不替代具体领域的实验与计算方法。
boundaryEn: These references guide method documentation, data transparency, and validation governance. They are not material-performance evidence and do not replace domain-specific experiments or calculations.

standardFields.labelZh: 字段级来源与核查状态
假设、适用条件与停止条件
验证设计、基准与通过门槛
standardFields.labelEn: Validation design, benchmarks, and pass gates

standardFields.labelZh: 不确定性、缺失数据与失败模式
standardFields.labelEn: Uncertainty, missing data, and failure modes

standardFields.labelZh: 可声明结论与明确非声明
版本、变更记录与引用出口
standardFields.labelEn: Version, change record, and citation entry

frameworks.title: Materials Methodology
frameworks.strengthZh: 按材料性质拆分计算方法，并把计算细节、适用对象与相关说明放在稳定目录中。
frameworks.strengthEn: Separates calculation methods by material property and keeps calculation details, scope, and related explanations in a stable directory.
frameworks.tradeoffZh: 侧重计算材料学，不直接覆盖数据治理、部署风险和实验验证闭环。
frameworks.tradeoffEn: Primarily computational-materials documentation; it does not by itself cover data governance, deployment risk, or experimental validation loops.
frameworks.adoptedZh: 采用按科研任务分模块的目录、公式入口和完整方法深链接。
frameworks.adoptedEn: Adopted as task-based method modules with formula entries and stable deep links.

frameworks.title: Deployment Safety Hub
frameworks.strengthZh: 按具体系统和版本公开评估、风险与缓解措施，便于区分不同版本的证据。
frameworks.strengthEn: Publishes evaluations, measured risks, and mitigations by system and version, making version-specific evidence explicit.
frameworks.tradeoffZh: 系统卡面向 AI 部署安全，不能直接替代材料化学方法与实验质量控制。
frameworks.tradeoffEn: System cards address AI deployment safety and cannot replace materials-chemistry methods or experimental quality control.
frameworks.adoptedZh: 采用版本化方法卡、验证状态、风险边界和明确非声明。
frameworks.adoptedEn: Adopted as versioned method cards, validation states, risk boundaries, and explicit non-claims.

frameworks.title: Data Cards Playbook
frameworks.strengthZh: 把数据透明度拆成提问、检查、回答和审计，并强调受众、用途、版本与新增知识。
frameworks.strengthEn: Structures data transparency around asking, inspecting, answering, and auditing, with explicit attention to audiences, use cases, versions, and new knowledge.
frameworks.tradeoffZh: 维护字段较多，若没有自动派生和责任边界，文档容易过期。
frameworks.tradeoffEn: The documentation surface is substantial and can become stale without derived fields and clear ownership.
frameworks.adoptedZh: 采用字段级溯源、数据库连接、缺失状态和来源覆盖视图。
frameworks.adoptedEn: Adopted as field-level provenance, database connections, missing states, and source-coverage views.

frameworks.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0
frameworks.strengthZh: 以治理、映射、测量和管理组织持续风险管理，并提供可引用的正式出版物。
frameworks.strengthEn: Organizes continuous risk management through govern, map, measure, and manage, with a citable official publication.
frameworks.tradeoffZh: 框架是跨行业高层结构，具体科研阈值和证伪标准仍须由项目定义。
frameworks.tradeoffEn: It is a high-level cross-sector framework; project-specific scientific thresholds and falsification criteria still need to be defined.
frameworks.adoptedZh: 采用统一状态、条件门控、验证责任和持续版本治理。
frameworks.adoptedEn: Adopted as unified states, condition gates, validation ownership, and continuous version governance.
